All solids transferred from the biological process to the interchange tanks are first passed through a 250 micron rotary drum screen to remove inert non-biodegradable material, which is compacted and conveyed to a separate dumpster.

The project involved replacement of the existing aerated pond treatment system with new facilities including coarse screening, grit removal, and fine screening; flow equalization; a new bioreactor with biological nutrient removal capability; membrane system; ultraviolet disinfection.
Beginning in late 2023, a new biosolids conveyor belt was implemented, and the biosolids now go to a facility that processes them so that it can be used on agricultural crops of any type.
